technology_name: Binary Blended Geopolymer Railway Sleepers with Iron Ore Tailings and Steel Fibers
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Industrial mining by-products like iron ore tailings go unutilized, creating environmental overhead while railway infrastructures require cement alternative materials.
description: A binary blended Engineered Geopolymer Composite (EGC) solution integrating iron ore tailings and micro-steel fiber reinforcements to yield a low-fiber content structural matrix (less than 2% volume) behaving like Engineered Cementitious Composites (ECC).
applications: Eco-friendly railway track systems, mine waste reclamation materials, prestressed heavy-duty industrial foundations, and high-tensile structural building blocks.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
